producer_contract_assessment.rationale: producer.py uses datetime.isoformat() which produces a 'T' separator with no space (C2), writes UTF-8 JSON Lines with one complete event object per line preserving all declared fields and order (C3), and keeps public names, call signatures, and file ownership unchanged (C1).

recipient_integration_plan.rationale: processor.py violates C4 by opening the output file with encoding='latin-1' instead of 'utf-8'. It also violates C5 by wrapping each processed event in an envelope dict {'data': processed} instead of writing bare event objects at the top level, which would cause sink.py to fail when accessing event['event_id'] directly. These are processor defects that must be fixed to meet its public responsibilities when paired with a conforming producer.
